On my lunch break, I overheard an Arab guy and an African lady talking about their spouses. The Arab guy was talking about how they cook together every Saturday, but the African lady seemed appalled by the idea of helping to cook, and reported not even liking their spouse leaving the house when there was still housework to be done. Who is respectful of their spouse?
A. Can't answer
B. The African lady
C. The Arab guy
